risk_if_not_implemented: Without Pre-Deployment Patch Testing, known and exploitable vulnerabilities may remain unaddressed, giving adversaries readily available entry points. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Business / Service Interruption (R-BC-1), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Vulnerability Scanning
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to detect vulnerabilities and configuration errors by routine vulnerability scanning of systems and applications.
compensating_control_1.justification: Vulnerability Scanning (VPM-12) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Pre-Deployment Patch Testing (VPM-10) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Secure Baseline Configurations
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.
compensating_control_2.justification: Secure Baseline Configurations (CFG-04) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Pre-Deployment Patch Testing (VPM-10) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
